lines.trans: Ah, a comfortable wooden bench in the shade—my feet approve of Clue Four!
Listen to the final rhyme: Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together.

words.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

lines.trans: Bring all four corners together... hand me Cards One, Two, and Three, Clara!

words.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

lines.trans: Wait—look at the faint blue lines drawn along the outer edges of each card!
Turn them face up on the flat bench slat like four tiles of one square...
Card One top left, Card Two top right, Card Three bottom left, Card Four bottom right!
Incredible! Together the four backs form a bird-eye drawing of the Lemon Tree Inn!
There is our courtyard tree, there are the arched windows of Room Nine...
And look up on the second-floor wooden courtyard balcony—a bright red painted star!
Why did the mapmaker paint a red star on our upstairs courtyard balcony?!
Perhaps the small wax-sealed envelope in your pocket has the answer, Clara!
We walked every clue honestly—even Ernesto and his extra circle—so let us open it!
Ah, a comfortable wooden bench in the shade—my feet approve of Clue Four!
Listen to the final rhyme: Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together.

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Indicates position or movement downward.

examples.text: La cocina está abajo.
examples.trans: The kitchen is downstairs.

examples.text: Te espero abajo en el patio.
examples.trans: I will wait for you downstairs in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

meanings.note: Expresses sudden realization or understanding.

examples.text: ¡Ah, ya entiendo el mapa!
examples.trans: Ah, now I understand the map!

examples.text: ¿Ah, sí? Qué buena noticia.
examples.trans: Oh really? What good news.

meanings.note: Points to something at medium distance or near the listener.

examples.text: Deja las llaves ahí en la mesa.
examples.trans: Leave the keys there on the table.

examples.text: Ahí viene el autobús.
examples.trans: There comes the bus.

meanings.note: Alto y claro means 'loud and clear'.

examples.text: Es una pieza alta.
examples.trans: It is a tall piece.

examples.text: Alto y claro. ¿Estás junto a la fuentecita de piedra?
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you beside the little stone fountain?

aprobar.gloss: to approve; to pass (an inspection or exam)

meanings.en: to approve; to pass (an inspection or exam)
meanings.note: Stem-changing o -> ue in stressed present forms (apruebo, aprueba); participle aprobado means 'approved / passed'.

examples.text: El ayuntamiento aprobó la licencia del café histórico.
examples.trans: The city council approved the licence for the historic café.

examples.text: Mi hermana aprobó el examen de música con muy buena nota.
examples.trans: My sister passed the music exam with a very high mark.

meanings.note: Architectural stone archway or violin bow.

examples.text: El arco está aquí.
examples.trans: The arch is here.

examples.text: Vemos los arcos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the archs from the door.

meanings.note: Opposite of abajo.

examples.text: Las habitaciones están arriba.
examples.trans: The bedrooms are upstairs.

examples.text: Mira arriba hacia el balcón.
examples.trans: Look up toward the balcony.

meanings.note: Así que means 'so / therefore'.

examples.text: Hazlo así, despacio.
examples.trans: Do it like this, slowly.

examples.text: Llueve mucho, así que entramos.
examples.trans: It is raining hard, so let us go inside.

meanings.note: Plural azules; azul marino means 'navy blue'.

examples.text: Es una pieza azul.
examples.trans: It is a blue piece.

examples.text: Espere, ¡es azul oscuro, igual que la suya!
examples.trans: Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!

meanings.note: Iconic painted ceramic tiles found in Valencian and Andalusian courtyards, fountains, and kitchens.

examples.text: Las cuatro tarjetas parecen cuatro azulejos de un cuadrado.
examples.trans: The four cards look like four tiles of a single square.

examples.text: La fuente del patio está decorada con azulejos azules y blancos.
examples.trans: The courtyard fountain is decorated with blue and white tiles.

meanings.note: Drops the written accent in the plural: los balcones.

examples.text: Hay una estrella roja pintada en el balcón de madera.
examples.trans: There is a red star painted on the wooden balcony.

examples.text: Colgaremos farolillos desde el balcón de la planta alta.
examples.trans: We will hang paper lanterns from the upstairs balcony.

meanings.note: Means both a wooden bench in a park or square and a financial bank.

examples.text: Nos sentamos en el banco de madera a la sombra.
examples.trans: We sat down on the wooden bench in the shade.

examples.text: La flecha de latón apunta hacia el banco del parque.
examples.trans: The brass arrow points toward the park bench.

meanings.note: Also denotes the pouring lip or opening of a jug or tunnel.

examples.text: La boca está aquí.
examples.trans: The mouth is here.

examples.text: Vemos las bocas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the mouths from the door.

meanings.note: Coat or trouser pocket.

examples.text: El bolsillo está aquí.
examples.trans: The pocket is here.

examples.text: Vemos los bolsillos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the pockets from the door.

meanings.note: Masculine noun (el borde de la mesa / de la ventana).

examples.text: No dejes el vaso lleno tan cerca del borde.
examples.trans: Do not leave the full glass so close to the edge.

examples.text: Lijamos suaves los bordes de madera antes de pintar.
examples.trans: We sanded the wooden edges smooth before painting.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: El suelo está limpio y brillante.
examples.trans: The floor is clean and shiny.

examples.text: Tiene unos ojos brillantes.
examples.trans: She has bright eyes.

meanings.note: Invariable before masculine or feminine singular nouns (cada día, cada mañana).

examples.text: Abro la cafetería cada mañana.
examples.trans: I open the cafe every morning.

examples.text: Cada habitación tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Each room has its own key.

meanings.note: Feminine form: la cartógrafa.

examples.text: El cartógrafo dibujó cada calle estrecha del casco antiguo.
examples.trans: The mapmaker drew every narrow street of the old quarter.

examples.text: Aquel viajero era un joven cartógrafo que hacía mapas a mano.
examples.trans: That traveller was a young mapmaker who drew maps by hand.

meanings.note: En casa = at home (without article).

examples.text: La casa está aquí.
examples.trans: The house is here.

examples.text: Vemos las casas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the houses from the door.

meanings.note: Adjective from cerrar.

examples.text: Es una pieza cerrada.
examples.trans: It is a closed piece.

examples.text: ¡Buenos días! Disculpe, ¿está cerrada la puerta?
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

meanings.note: Unaccented como compares or gives a reason (distinct from interrogative cómo).

examples.text: Está fría como el agua del río.
examples.trans: It is as cold as river water.

examples.text: Todo funciona como debe ser.
examples.trans: Everything works just as it should.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Also used as a masculine noun (el cuadrado, 'the square') and in metros cuadrados ('square metres').

examples.text: Sacaron un paquete cuadrado envuelto en lino.
examples.trans: They lifted out a square bundle wrapped in linen.

examples.text: En la lata había cuatro tarjetas cuadradas de papel.
examples.trans: In the tin there were four square paper cards.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Always carries a written accent on the first syllable.

examples.text: Es una pieza cómoda.
examples.trans: It is a comfortable piece.

examples.text: Tengo una manta abrigada, así que esta noche estoy muy cómodo.
examples.trans: I have a warm blanket, so tonight I am very comfortable.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: A la derecha / a mano derecha = on the right.

examples.text: La derecha está aquí.
examples.trans: The right is here.

examples.text: Vemos las derechas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rights from the door.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb; the noun is el dibujo, a drawing.

examples.text: Mi hija dibuja un gato.
examples.trans: My daughter is drawing a cat.

examples.text: ¿Me dibujas el camino al hotel?
examples.trans: Will you sketch me the way to the hotel?

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'to' before things (escucha el agua).

examples.text: Escucho los pájaros desde mi cama.
examples.trans: I listen to the birds from my bed.

examples.text: Escuchamos la lluvia sobre las tejas.
examples.trans: We listened to the rain on the tiles.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

esquina.gloss: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)

meanings.en: corner (outer street corner or cake corner)
meanings.note: Outer corner where two streets meet, or the crisp corner of a baking tray.

examples.text: La esquina está aquí.
examples.trans: The corner is here.

examples.text: Vemos las esquinas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the corners from the door.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: De cinco estrellas = five-star.

examples.text: La estrella está aquí.
examples.trans: The star is here.

examples.text: Vemos las estrellas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the stars from the door.

meanings.note: Contrasts with interior ('inner; indoor'); plural is exteriores.

examples.text: Mirad las suaves líneas azules por los bordes exteriores de cada tarjeta.
examples.trans: Look at the faint blue lines along the outer edges of each card.

examples.text: Pintaron de verde las contraventanas exteriores de la galería.
examples.trans: They painted the outdoor shutters of the sunroom green.

meanings.note: Invariable in singular (esquinas extra).

examples.text: Es una pieza extra.
examples.trans: It is an extra piece.

examples.text: Recién salido del horno: ¡bizcocho de limón de los viernes con esquinas extra!
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake with extra corner pieces!

meanings.note: As a masculine noun (el final), means the ending of a song, book, or day.

examples.text: El final del vals baja el ritmo poco a poco.
examples.trans: The ending of the waltz slows the tempo little by little.

examples.text: Al final de la tarde probamos las dos sopas.
examples.trans: At the end of the afternoon we tasted both soups.

formar.gloss: to form; to make up; to shape

meanings.en: to form; to make up; to shape
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb used when pieces unite into a whole image or group.

examples.text: Juntos, los cuatro reversos forman un dibujo de la posada.
examples.trans: Together, the four backs form a drawing of the inn.

examples.text: Los vecinos formaron un corro alegre alrededor del piano.
examples.trans: The neighbours formed a cheerful circle around the piano.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Plural habitaciones.

examples.text: La habitación está aquí.
examples.trans: The room is here.

examples.text: Vemos las habitaciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rooms from the door.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Adds an unexpected or emphatic item.

examples.text: Incluso el timbre estuvo callado hoy.
examples.trans: Even the buzzer stayed quiet today.

examples.text: Trabaja incluso los domingos.
examples.trans: He works even on Sundays.

examples.text: Tenía una trama increíble.
examples.trans: She had an incredible storyline.

examples.text: Es una actriz increíble.
examples.trans: She's an incredible actress.

meanings.note: A la izquierda = on/to the left.

examples.text: La izquierda está aquí.
examples.trans: The left is here.

examples.text: Vemos las izquierdas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lefts from the door.

juntar.gloss: to put together; to join (juntarse = to meet, gather)

meanings.en: to put together; to join (juntarse = to meet, gather)
meanings.note: Reflexive juntarse means 'to get together, meet up, or combine'.

examples.text: Juntamos dos mesas pequeñas para sentarnos todos.
examples.trans: We pushed two small tables together so we could all sit.

examples.text: Los viernes por la tarde se juntan los vecinos en el patio.
examples.trans: On Friday afternoons the neighbours gather in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Junto a + noun works like a preposition meaning 'beside / next to'.

examples.text: Siéntate junto a la ventana.
examples.trans: Sit next to the window.

examples.text: Trabajamos juntos en la posada.
examples.trans: We work together at the guesthouse.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Red or coloured wax melted onto envelopes to stamp a traditional seal (sello de lacre).

examples.text: El pequeño sobre lleva un sello antiguo de lacre rojo.
examples.trans: The small envelope bears an old red sealing-wax stamp.

examples.text: Clara levantó el lacre con mucho cuidado sin romper el papel.
examples.trans: Clara lifted the sealing wax very carefully without tearing the paper.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Fruit tree bearing lemons (el limón -> el limonero).

examples.text: El limonero está aquí.
examples.trans: The lemon tree is here.

examples.text: Vemos los limoneros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lemon trees from the door.

meanings.note: Formed from the feminine adjective limpia + -mente; used both for neatness and for playing fair.

examples.text: Hemos recorrido cada pista limpiamente por toda la calle.
examples.trans: We walked every clue fair and square all along the street.

examples.text: El equipo ganó el juego limpiamente y sin hacer trampas.
examples.trans: The team won the game fairly without cheating.

meanings.note: Drops its written accent in the plural (los listones); denotes a narrow flat strip of wood on a bench or crate.

examples.text: Javier puso las cuatro tarjetas sobre el listón plano del banco.
examples.trans: Javier laid the four cards on the flat slat of the bench.

examples.text: Tomás lijó los listones de madera para arreglar la silla.
examples.trans: Tomas sanded the wooden slats to mend the chair.

meanings.note: Los viernes means 'every Friday / on Fridays'.

examples.text: Los vecinos vienen a desayunar.
examples.trans: The neighbours come for breakfast.

examples.text: Daba clases de piano los viernes.
examples.trans: She taught piano lessons on Fridays.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! is Spain's most common everyday farewell.

examples.text: Cruza el puente y luego gira.
examples.trans: Cross the bridge and then turn.

examples.text: ¡Hasta luego, que tengas buen día!
examples.trans: See you later, have a good day!

meanings.note: La primera línea = the top line.

examples.text: La línea está aquí.
examples.trans: The line is here.

examples.text: Vemos las líneas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lines from the door.

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La madera está aquí.
examples.trans: The wood is here.

examples.text: Vemos las maderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the woods from the door.

meanings.note: Plural mis (mi llave / mis llaves); unaccented, distinct from pronoun mí.

examples.text: Mi maleta es azul marino.
examples.trans: My suitcase is navy blue.

examples.text: Mis apuntes están en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: My notes are in my pocket.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with the thing possessed (nuestro patio, nuestra posada).

examples.text: Nuestra posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: Our guesthouse has eight rooms.

examples.text: Nuestros vecinos toman café aquí.
examples.trans: Our neighbours have coffee here.

meanings.note: Las nueve = nine o'clock.

examples.text: El tren llega a las nueve en punto.
examples.trans: The train arrives at nine on the dot.

examples.text: Vimos un nueve sobre diez.
examples.trans: We saw a nine out of ten.

pasar.gloss: to pass; to come in (¡Pase!); to happen

meanings.en: to pass; to come in (¡Pase!); to happen
meanings.note: ¿Qué pasa? = What's wrong?; No pasa nada = No problem.

examples.text: ¡Pase, por favor, y siéntese!
examples.trans: Come in, please, and have a seat!

examples.text: Pasa la farmacia verde a la derecha.
examples.trans: Pass the green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: Hermano pequeño = younger brother; de pequeño = as a child.

examples.text: Es una pieza pequeña.
examples.trans: It is a small piece.

examples.text: Hay una pequeña tarjeta de cartón atada al asa.
examples.trans: There is a small cardboard card tied to the handle.

meanings.note: Estar de pie means 'to stand / be standing'; ir a pie means 'to walk'.

examples.text: Después de seis horas de pie agradezco una silla.
examples.trans: After six hours on my feet I welcome a chair.

examples.text: Descansa los pies sobre este taburete bajo de madera.
examples.trans: Rest your feet on this low wooden stool.

meanings.note: Past-participle adjective from pintar.

examples.text: Es una pieza pintada.
examples.trans: It is a painted piece.

examples.text: Solo una llave dorada pintada encima de la puerta. Enséñale esta válvula al dependiente.
examples.trans: Only a painted golden key above the door. Show the clerk this valve.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: En primavera pintamos la puerta azul.
examples.trans: In spring we paint the blue door.

examples.text: El abuelo pintó una llave dorada.
examples.trans: Grandfather painted a golden key.

meanings.note: In a mystery or treasure hunt, una pista is a clue; also means a dance floor (pista de baile) or sports court (pista de tenis).

examples.text: Lee la pista de la postal una vez más, Clara.
examples.trans: Read the clue on the postcard one more time, Clara.

examples.text: Seguimos las cuatro pistas por la calle de los Tilos.
examples.trans: We followed all four clues along Calle de los Tilos.

meanings.note: Architectural drawing or city street map.

examples.text: El plano está aquí.
examples.trans: The blueprint is here.

examples.text: Vemos los planos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the blueprints from the door.

meanings.note: Planta baja = ground floor; primera planta = first floor; also a green plant.

examples.text: La planta está aquí.
examples.trans: The floor / storey is here.

examples.text: Vemos las plantas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the floor / storeys from the door.

poner.gloss: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)

meanings.en: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)
meanings.note: Irregular: pongo, pon, puse, puesto; ponerse nervioso = get nervous.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas limpias en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two clean cups on the table.

examples.text: Pon la maleta junto al mostrador.
examples.trans: Set the suitcase beside the counter.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Charming small inn with rooms around a courtyard.

examples.text: La posada está aquí.
examples.trans: The inn is here.

examples.text: Vemos las posadas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the inns from the door.

meanings.note: Garden songbird.

examples.text: El pájaro está aquí.
examples.trans: The bird is here.

examples.text: Vemos los pájaros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the birds from the door.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: Variant of quizá.

examples.text: Quizás olvidó el paraguas en el taxi.
examples.trans: Perhaps she left her umbrella in the taxi.

examples.text: Quizás podamos abrir mañana.
examples.trans: Maybe we can open tomorrow.

qué.gloss: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)

meanings.en: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)
meanings.note: Used in questions (¿qué hora es?) and exclamations (¡qué alivio!).

examples.text: ¿Qué hora es ahora mismo?
examples.trans: What time is it right now?

examples.text: ¡Qué mañana tan luminosa!
examples.trans: What a bright morning!

recorrer.gloss: to walk along; to travel through; to cover (a route)

meanings.en: to walk along; to travel through; to cover (a route)
meanings.note: Takes a direct object without a preposition: recorrer la calle ('to walk the length of the street'), recorrer las cuatro pistas.

examples.text: ¿Cuánto tardaríamos en recorrer las cuatro pistas del barrio?
examples.trans: How long would it take us to walk all four clues in the neighbourhood?

examples.text: Recorrimos toda la calle de los Tilos bajo el sol.
examples.trans: We walked the whole length of Calle de los Tilos in the sunshine.

meanings.note: Pairs with dar or tener for giving or having an answer to a question or mystery.

examples.text: Quizás el pequeño sobre cerrado tiene la respuesta que buscamos.
examples.trans: Perhaps the small sealed envelope has the answer we are looking for.

examples.text: Enviamos una respuesta rápida por correo urgente esta mañana.
examples.trans: We sent a quick reply by express mail this morning.

meanings.note: Refers to the flip side of a card, coin, page, or painting.

examples.text: Los cuatro reversos de las tarjetas forman un mapa del patio.
examples.trans: The four backs of the cards form a map of the courtyard.

examples.text: Escribió la fecha y su nombre en el reverso de la fotografía.
examples.trans: He wrote the date and his name on the back of the photograph.

meanings.note: Used for a short rhyming clue, poem, or song lyric.

examples.text: Escuchad con atención la rima final de la cuarta tarjeta.
examples.trans: Listen closely to the final rhyme on the fourth card.

examples.text: Cada pista del mapa está escrita con una pequeña rima.
examples.trans: Each clue on the map is written with a little rhyme.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number.

examples.text: Es una pieza roja.
examples.trans: It is a red piece.

examples.text: ¡Dígales que la mía tiene una cinta roja en el bolsillo de arriba!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: me siento, ¡siéntese!).

examples.text: Siéntese junto a la ventana, por favor.
examples.trans: Sit down by the window, please.

examples.text: Nos sentamos bajo el limonero.
examples.trans: We sit down under the lemon tree.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

meanings.note: A la sombra means 'in the shade'.

examples.text: Nos sentamos a la sombra fresca del limonero.
examples.trans: We sit in the cool shade of the lemon tree.

examples.text: La lámpara dibuja una sombra suave en la pared.
examples.trans: The lamp casts a soft shadow on the wall.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: Es una pieza suave.
examples.trans: It is a soft piece.

examples.text: Y mire: esta chaqueta de lana suave está limpia y nueva. Pruébela.
examples.trans: And look: this soft wool cardigan is clean and unworn. Try it on.

meanings.note: Pagar con tarjeta = pay by card.

examples.text: La tarjeta está aquí.
examples.trans: The card is here.

examples.text: Vemos las tarjetas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the cards from the door.

tener.gloss: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)

meanings.en: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)
meanings.note: Used in idioms: tener hambre/frío/miedo/prisa/razón; tener que = must.

examples.text: Tenemos ocho habitaciones tranquilas.
examples.trans: We have eight quiet rooms.

examples.text: Tengo que cerrar la ventana ahora.
examples.trans: I have to close the window now.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Ponemos tres mesas bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We set three tables under the tree.

examples.text: Empieza con tres frases cortas.
examples.trans: Start with three short sentences.

meanings.note: Unaccented possessive (tu llave / tus llaves), distinct from accented pronoun tú.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está tu caja de herramientas?
examples.trans: Where is your toolbox?

examples.text: Reconocí tu letra enseguida.
examples.trans: I recognized your handwriting right away.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Shortens to un before masculine singular nouns.

examples.text: Toma uno recién salido del horno.
examples.trans: Take one fresh out of the oven.

examples.text: Contamos del uno al ocho.
examples.trans: We count from one to eight.

meanings.note: Una ventana soleada = a sunny window.

examples.text: La ventana está aquí.
examples.trans: The window is here.

examples.text: Vemos las ventanas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the windows from the door.

vista.gloss: view; sight; eyesight (a la vista = in sight)

meanings.en: view; sight; eyesight (a la vista = in sight)
meanings.note: Buena vista = sharp eyes / a lovely view.

examples.text: La vista está aquí.
examples.trans: The view is here.

examples.text: Vemos las vistas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the views from the door.

vuelta.gloss: turn; return (de vuelta = back; media vuelta = turn around)

meanings.en: turn; return (de vuelta = back; media vuelta = turn around)
meanings.note: Dar una vuelta = take a stroll / make one turn.

examples.text: La vuelta está aquí.
examples.trans: The turn is here.

examples.text: Vemos las vueltas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the turns from the door.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: Plural los árboles.

examples.text: El árbol está aquí.
examples.trans: The tree is here.

examples.text: Vemos los árboles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the trees from the door.
